about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We're here to help you write a better one.
about_para_1: We started Professional Gardening Services because we saw too many beautiful Manchester gardens abandoned or neglected. After 15 years on this patch, we've worked on everything from tiny courtyards in Didsbury to sprawling grounds in Altrincham. We're still here because we love what we do and because repeat customers trust us to get it right.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen first, deliver honestly, and take pride in every detail. We don't upsell or overcomplicate—we show you what needs doing, give a fair price, and turn up when we say we will. Whether it's a one-off tidy-up or a multi-season garden transformation, we treat your outdoor space with the care it deserves.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our back garden. Had an overgrown mess when they started, now it's our favourite place to sit in the summer. The lads were respectful, tidy, and finished on time. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Got a free quote, which was honest and detailed. They explained everything they'd do and why. Three months on and the planting is thriving. Best decision we made. Proper tradesmen.
